rationale: Description-shaped skill: triggering correctly is the entire job (it's a navigation map, no workflow body to evaluate behaviorally). Eval tests whether the description fires on real session-start / which-skill-applies prompts and stays quiet on near-miss prompts that should route to a specific skill instead.

evals.prompt: I'm starting a session in this repo, where do I begin?
What skills are available for me to use here?
I'm not sure which skill applies to my task — help me pick.
Give me the lay of the land for this skill pack.
I want a navigation map of what's installed from agents-skills.
Which skill should I use for my work?
How do I figure out which skill fits my situation?
I'm new here and don't know where to start.
Help me debug a failing test in test_users.py.
Start a TDD cycle for the new validation function.
I want to write a spec for the auth flow.
Verify the build is green before I commit.
Create a new skill called export-md.
Which test framework should I use for this Python project?
I'm starting work on a new file — which Python style guide applies?
